name: @jengo/storage
description: Universal TypeScript/JavaScript client library for Jengo Storage featuring chunked uploads, resumability, direct-to-cloud S3/R2 transfers, image preview generation, dropzone UI, and React/Vue/Svelte framework adapters.

functions.name: uploadChunked
functions.signature: uploadChunked(file: File | Blob, options?: ChunkedUploadOptions): Promise<UploadResult>
functions.description: Upload a file in chunks to /storage/upload/chunk with progress, pause, resume, and retry.

functions.name: uploadStandard
functions.signature: uploadStandard(file: File | Blob, options?: StandardUploadOptions): Promise<UploadResult>
functions.description: Upload a file via a standard single HTTP POST request.

functions.name: uploadDirectCloud
functions.signature: uploadDirectCloud(file: File | Blob, options?: DirectCloudUploadOptions): Promise<UploadResult>
functions.description: Upload directly to S3 or Cloudflare R2 using a presigned upload URL.

functions.name: generatePreview
functions.description: Generate an in-browser thumbnail or preview data URL for an image or PDF.

uploaders.description: Manages chunk slicing, concurrent dispatch, progress callbacks, and completion notification.
Coordinates presigned URL requests with direct S3/R2 binary PUT streaming.
